limits: PR metadata/body and listed changed paths are historical observations, not a dependency closure. Partial/zero/omitted path listings deliberately remain unknown.

Known base ancestry is not in itself a blocker to ordered batching; some dependent PRs can share a final gate after review. Shared files do not prove conflict; disjoint files do not prove independence.

No member has explicit historical nonurgent staging approval or exact composite-tree receipt. The all-hold scenario is a conservative policy boundary, not a cost forecast or a conclusion that batching cannot work.
